Victoria

#### What's great

I tried theORQL on a couple annoying frontend issues (one CSS layout bug + one flaky interaction) and it's the first "AI for frontend" tool that didn't feel like guessing.

The big difference is it can actually see what rendered (screenshots) and then verify the change in Chrome before handing you a diff. The UI > code mapping is also legit, clicking the broken element and jumping to the owning component saves a ton of time vs. bouncing between DevTools and VS Code.

Only downside for me right now: I'd love Firefox/Safari support too, since I still have to debug cross-browser issues there. But for 95% of my workflow, this is honestly a game-changer.
